source.generatorPaper: Islam et al. 2022, Cell Genomics, DOI 10.1016/j.xgen.2022.100179
source.dataset: Published SBS synthetic benchmark: 2,700 spectra, 300 per each of nine cancer types, generated from 21 COSMIC reference signatures; archived COSMIC v3.3 GRCh37 SBS catalog shape contains 78 signature columns.

subset.method: First sample ID in each cancer-type group after grouping the archived sample names by the prefix before ::.

adapters.runtime: local adapters; browser adapters skipped because the WebR deconstructSigs process did not advance within the bounded runtime test

comparisonContract.purpose: A semantic evaluation contract for comparing package outputs after execution; a shared matrix shape alone is not a claim of equivalent optimization behavior.

contextOrder.representation: explicit ordered array of context labels
contextOrder.rule: The exact array is serialized and passed to every adapter; position i has the same context label in spectra and signature matrices.

input.spectraUnits: caller-supplied matrix values; the contract does not silently reinterpret counts as fractions
input.signatureUnits: caller-supplied profile values; the comparison layer normalizes each complete signature column before reconstruction metrics
input.catalogCompleteness: the complete selected catalog is retained; omitted output signatures are represented as zero in the canonical vector

toolNativeUnits.deconstructSigs: relative weights returned by whichSignatures, normalized over the complete catalog
toolNativeUnits.sigminer: relative exposures when type=relative; the parsed vector is normalized over the complete catalog
toolNativeUnits.SigProfilerAssignment: package-native activity output, converted by the comparison layer to complete-catalog relative fractions
toolNativeUnits.MuSiCal: package-native refit exposures, converted by the comparison layer to complete-catalog relative fractions

output.conversion: Fill absent signature columns with zero, clamp non-finite/negative values to zero for comparison, then divide each complete vector by its positive total.

cutoff.rule: values below the cutoff are set to zero

reporting.order: Convert to complete-catalog relative fractions first; apply the reporting cutoff second; renormalize retained values third.
reporting.activeSignature: a signature is active for reporting when its post-conversion fraction is greater than or equal to the cutoff
reporting.inactiveSignature: an inactive signature remains present in the complete vector with value zero
reporting.omittedSignature: a package-omitted column is not treated as absent evidence; it is zero-filled and counted as an omitted output column
reporting.unassigned: package-specific unassigned or unexplained components are not renamed as a catalog signature; they remain a separate package-native field or are excluded from catalog-vector metrics and explicitly reported

options.packageDefaultsNotEquivalentAcrossTools: Package defaults remain part of each adapter provenance record unless an option is explicitly supplied; they are not treated as matched algorithms.

comparisonContract.interpretationBoundary: The contract standardizes labels, units, catalog membership, filtering order, and metrics. It does not equalize optimization objective, sparsity, signature selection, normalization internals, or post-processing inside the packages.

catalog.spectraUnits: caller-supplied matrix values; the contract does not silently reinterpret counts as fractions
catalog.signatureUnits: caller-supplied profile values; the comparison layer normalizes each complete signature column before reconstruction metrics
catalog.catalogCompleteness: the complete selected catalog is retained; omitted output signatures are represented as zero in the canonical vector
catalog.normalization: each signature column normalized to unit L1 sum before reconstruction metrics

harmonization.catalog: All 78 archived catalog columns passed to every adapter; each catalog column was normalized to sum to one before reconstruction metrics.
harmonization.exposureUnits: All adapter outputs converted to relative fractions by dividing each sample's complete 78-signature vector by its positive total.
harmonization.filtering: Common post-fit activity cutoff of 0.01; values below the cutoff set to zero, followed by renormalization; no package-specific sparsity threshold was added by this analysis.
harmonization.inactiveSignatures: Complete 78-signature output vectors retained; missing or inactive signatures represented as zero.
harmonization.numericalTolerance: Values are treated as zero only through the explicit 1% activity rule; metric calculations retain full floating-point output before reporting rounding.
harmonization.activeSignatureDefinition: Predicted active if harmonized fraction >= 0.01; archived truth active if the published true activity is > 0.
harmonization.reconstructionMetric: Cosine similarity between the observed normalized SBS96 spectrum and the normalized spectrum reconstructed from the harmonized exposure fractions and normalized catalog.
harmonization.burdenDefinition: Observed SBS mutation counts in the noise-free archive input; low/middle/high tertiles contain three of the nine spectra each and are held fixed across noise levels.
